pages.title: Agri research — Karna-18 sugarcane, coconut root wilt

facts.text: Karna-18 (Co-18022): sugarcane by Sugarcane Breeding Institute Regional Centre, Karnal — salinity and drought tolerant; resists red rot, top borer; for NW India

facts.text: Root wilt of coconut: caused by phytoplasma (phloem); Kerala, TN, Karnataka; first identified ~150 years ago at Erattupetta (Kerala); reduces yield, does not kill tree
